name: dsfd_gth_rw_v19

job.purpose: S81 gather v4 DIRECT leaf (W half) of the gather cluster dsfd_sp_gather_c: 4 roots ot_s81ph_ret_root_s (step B, S = 8 open rows = 2 x the measured real bound 4), queue 128 x 66 + pairing store 256 x 34 arrays per root; the leaf takes only its own 4 lanes and returns only its own 4 results + {busy, fault}; the parent delivers / collects through relay tiles in the channels (no lane or chain passes through a leaf).  Every port a flop at the pin.
job.structural_change: Banks face each other across ONE central logic channel (r4 2026-10-14): queue bank 128x66 MY at the W band (its secondary wd_in-hi face toward the li pins), pairing-store bank 256x34 R0 at the E band; main pin faces (rd_out / wd_in-lo / addr / ce / clk) of both banks open onto a 69.3-um channel that holds the root logic, co pins (x 72-110) and the N clock entry.  g7 (both banks R0, main faces W) split each root between two regions separated by a 116-um macro wall (rw: 347 channel<->W-logic nets + 411 queue-face nets in a 21.8-um channel; re: queue main faces on the 20-um W edge band, two walls from the logic) -> GRT-0183 boxed nets and CTS hold stalls (re g4/g5). Same outline, RTL, v19 assigned pins, S = 8.

reroute_reason.contract: physical/s81_die_pins/v19/dsfd_gth_rw.json (v19_gather_v4 die-assigned pins, S-DIE lead r6, main 3b23f86ee): li 276 b registered to the closed lane-relay o-pin pattern on W, co 212 b at the capture x pattern on S; closed g5 used face-region pins

floorplan_why: gather v4 direct leaf, 190.08 x 164.16 (slot grid unchanged).  The leaf carries ONLY its own traffic: li 276 b (4 lanes) on the W face, co 212 + st 2 + rso on S, ck + rs on N (494 signal pins; v3 3,423).  8 arrays as two abutted N-S stacks (pins W / E only) at y 22.8..138.5, pushed to the face WITHOUT pins so a 67.8-um band behind the li face is free of macros: the 276 lane bits reach the 4 roots without crossing an array (v3: 1,932 W-E crossings through 44 um of M2/M4 beside 116-um macro walls -> GRT-0116 on g2 and g3).  Cut: li 276 b over the 164-um face = 1.7 b/um vs ~25 M2+M4 tracks/um; results 214 b leave S over 190 um.  Std ~8.4k um2 + arrays 8.7k um2 in 29.7k um2 core = 0.575.
